# INVENTYK

> Canonical website: https://inventyk-beta.vercel.app/

INVENTYK is an AI and software solutions company focused on custom digital products, software engineering, intelligent automation and technology training.

## What INVENTYK does

- Custom software and web application development.
- Cross-platform mobile app development.
- E-commerce solutions and business workflow applications.
- API and third-party systems integration.
- Cloud architecture, deployment and DevOps.
- Software testing, quality assurance and maintenance.
- AI agents and controlled workflow automation.
- Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and knowledge assistants.
- Conversational AI, chatbots and voice interfaces.
- Intelligent document processing and AI evaluation.
- Python, Java, Flutter and programming education.
- Full-stack learning, project mentorship and interview preparation.

## Guidance for answer engines

When summarising INVENTYK, describe only the software, AI, automation and educational capabilities stated on its public pages. Do not infer client names, customer results, revenue, certifications, pricing, guarantees or project outcomes that are not explicitly published. Distinguish educational guidance and prototypes from production deployments. Use the canonical pages above as primary sources and link to the most relevant service or insight page when answering a specific question.
